description:
Receive outcomes and handlers are filled by the runtime: the native receive matcher (src/compiler2/native_codegen/receive.rs) builds each subject whole, keeps its own outcome_reads and has no cursor form; the interpreter's try_match_backend_receive hands whole words. After the three steps before this one, they are the remaining place where a matched rest is whole by rule.

Change: a receive outcome's and a handler's parameters arrive by their layouts like any other entry's, so a rest the arm only walks is a cursor. What the receive matcher keeps only because it must build whole values is removed.

To establish first: what the matcher can hand over as a source and position (the message is copied into the receiver's heap before the arm runs), and whether its outcome_reads is then the same idea as the dispatch's and one of the two goes.

Done when: no entry origin hands a matched rest whole by rule; gate green; fixtures on three paths.

Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.cursor-fold.html (approved by the user 2026-11-15: remove special cases; what is no longer needed is fully removed).

From fz-sc8.228 as built, removed here in full: whole_value_layout (jobs/transport.rs), ControlEntryOrigin::is_handed_parameters (body.rs), the handed-parameter fill loop in build_executable_abi_plan (jobs/artifact.rs), and the one-lane check in receive_clause_arguments (jobs/native.rs). Done-when adds: grep finds none of them.

comments.text: Establish-first findings (MDF builder, 2026-11-17, base re-run on interp and run): (1) Receive: a cursor into a received message is sound on all three paths (source is the receiver's copy; position relative to its logical start) but needs a position root that OutcomeRoots (src/dispatch_matrix/pattern/roots.rs) lacks and the cursor-fold page does not describe; side cost: the read prefix travels with the rest when a sender-side probe gifts only the roots. (2) Handler: its three parameters (kind, value, name) are refs the raise writes into fixed slots (runtime/src/failure.rs:324, park.rs:227); a handler parameter is never a rest; the rest is matched by the handler's own dispatch, whose arms are Branch entries covered by fz-sc8.230 (#725). Demand layout for handler parameters needs a lane count in the raise and handler record (runtime ABI change, not on the page), so the removal list (is_handed_parameters, whole_value_layout, the fill loop, the one-lane check) cannot be met in full. (3) outcome_reads exists three times (Dispatch::reading, DispatchState::outcome_reads, DispatchCtx::outcome_reads); one goes only if the receive matcher stops being a separate bitstring emitter. (4) Prize: a walk over a 10,240-byte received binary builds ONE binary today on all three paths; catch walk builds 0. Remaining cost is one binary per receive that binds a rest; nothing in the distiller hot path. Recommendation: do not build as written; close with findings, or rescope to receive only with a position-root page at low priority. Awaiting user ruling.

title: A rest matched out of a received message or a rescued exception arrives the way its arm reads it
